game.name: Skylanders Giants (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It,Nl,Sv,No,Da,Fi)
game.desc: Skylanders Giants is an action/platform game for Xbox 360. You can play as creatures by controlling figurines that must be positioned on a base provided with the game. This sequel also gives the possibility to control giants, bigger characters that also have levels and increases to unlock. Older figures are also compatible.
